valenna.BattleSkill.885129.Description.en: Brawl check, requires a success or better | 5 hits [On Use] At 6 or more Poise, each hit deals +1 damage (max +1). Automatically selects the Game Target when chosen. The target cannot dodge. Each hit deals 1 base damage. Below 10 Eye of Precognition stacks, roll no additional damage die. At 10 Eye of Precognition stacks, roll 1d2. At 20, roll 1d4. At 30, roll 1d6. [On Use] Each hit deals +1 damage per 6 combined stacks of Burn and Tremor on the target (max +2). [On Use] Double the damage of the hit if the target is at half HP or lower. [On Use] Gain 3 Poise. [On Use] With at least 2 SP and while free of Frail and Unhinged, spend 2 SP and gain 1 Mang. [After Attack] Refill Acceleration Rounds to 10. [After Attack] Remove the target's Game Target mark. [On Kill] Mark another enemy next round. 【I】 1 + Eye of Precognition damage die [On Hit] Inflict 1 Burn and 1 Tremor. 【II】 1 + Eye of Precognition damage die [On Hit] Inflict 1 Burn and 1 Tremor. 【III】 1 + Eye of Precognition damage die [On Hit] Inflict 1 Burn and 1 Tremor. 【IV】 1 + Eye of Precognition damage die [On Hit] Inflict 1 Burn and 1 Tremor. [On Hit] Convert Tremor to Tremor - Scorch. 【V】 1 + Eye of Precognition damage die Spend up to 5 Acceleration Rounds. If Mang is spent, this hit gains +2 base damage. [On Hit] Inflict 1 Burn and 1 Tremor. [On Hit] Trigger Tremor Burst 3 times. [On Critical Hit] Trigger 2 additional bursts.

valenna.BattleSkill.885130.Description.zh: 准备预知。完整闪避敌方一次攻击行动后，对攻击者发动一次<color=#FFA15E>解兔</color>。
valenna.BattleSkill.885130.Description.en: Prepare <color=#8CD6EB>Precognition</color>. After dodging every hit of one enemy attack, counter with <color=#FFA15E>Sezionatura di Coniglio</color>.

valenna.BattleSkill.885151.Description.zh: <color=#55D8EF>[使用时]</color> 补满<color=#79CAD7>加速弹</color>，切换战斗背景和音乐。
valenna.BattleSkill.885151.Description.en: <color=#55D8EF>[On Use]</color> Refill <color=#79CAD7>Acceleration Rounds</color> and switch the battle background and music.

valenna.BattleSkill.885152.Description.zh:
使用预知闪避时，每层<color=#8CD6EB>预知眼</color>使本次检定成功区间额外⁣+1⁤，与<color=#8CD6EB>预知眼</color>本身的加成叠加。
可以闪避投掷物品、法术及自身攻击被敌人成功闪避后受到的回击等原本不可闪避的攻击。成功时，避开自己受到的该次效果。
这些特殊闪避不会触发[<color=#FFA15E>解兔</color>]。成功闪避敌方一次普通攻击的全部段数后，仍可用[<color=#FFA15E>解兔</color>]反击。
<color=#55D8EF>[使用时]</color> 补满<color=#79CAD7>加速弹</color>，每行动轮限⁣1次⁤。
<color=#A8E96D>[闪避成功时]</color> 获得⁣1层<color=#EBC556>呼吸法</color>⁤，每行动轮最多⁣2次⁤。
<color=#A8E96D>[闪避成功时]</color> 恢复⁣1点精神值⁤，每场战斗最多⁣2次⁤。
valenna.BattleSkill.885152.Description.en:
When dodging with <color=#8CD6EB>Precognition</color>, each stack of <color=#8CD6EB>Eye of Precognition</color> adds 1 more to this check's success range, stacking with the eye's own bonus.
You can dodge normally undodgeable attacks, including thrown items, spells, and counterattacks after an enemy dodges your attack. On a success, you avoid the effect on yourself.
These special dodges do not trigger [<color=#FFA15E>Sezionatura di Coniglio</color>]. Dodging every hit of a normal attack still lets you counter with [<color=#FFA15E>Sezionatura di Coniglio</color>].
<color=#55D8EF>[On Use]</color> Refill <color=#79CAD7>Acceleration Rounds</color>, once per action round.
<color=#A8E96D>[On Dodge]</color> Gain 1 <color=#EBC556>Poise</color>, up to twice per action round.
<color=#A8E96D>[On Dodge]</color> Restore 1 SP, up to twice per battle.

valenna.Buff.885131.Des.zh:
<color=#A8E96D>[命中时]</color> 各段独立判定暴击。每层提供⁣5%⁤暴击率，上限⁣100%⁤。
<color=#B3F26E>[暴击时]</color> 本段伤害按⁣1.2倍⁤结算，消耗⁣1层⁤。
若暴击判定时<color=#EBC556>呼吸法</color>超过⁣10层⁤，本段伤害改为⁣1.4倍⁤，额外消耗⁣1层⁤。
<color=#55D8EF>[回合结束时]</color> 减少⁣1层⁤。
valenna.Buff.885131.Des.en:
<color=#A8E96D>[On Hit]</color> Each hit rolls for a critical independently. Each stack adds 5% critical chance, up to 100%.
<color=#B3F26E>[On Critical]</color> Deal 1.2 times damage for this hit and spend 1 stack.
With more than 10 <color=#EBC556>Poise</color> when you roll for the critical, deal 1.4 times damage and spend 1 additional stack.
<color=#55D8EF>[Turn End]</color> Lose 1 stack.

valenna.Buff.885132.Des.zh:
<color=#FFA15E>[引爆时]</color> 混乱值增加<color=#FFA15E>震颤</color>层数的三分之一，向上取整，再消耗⁣1层<color=#FFA15E>震颤</color>⁤。
单次增量上限为目标意志的三分之一，向下取整；意志大于零时，上限至少为⁣1点⁤。
混乱条上限等于目标意志。填满后<color=#D196C7>昏迷</color>⁣1个行动轮⁤，解除后从零开始。
<color=#D196C7>昏迷</color>期间暂停积累混乱值。
<color=#55D8EF>[回合结束时]</color> 减少⁣1层⁤。
valenna.Buff.885132.Des.en:
<color=#FFA15E>[On Burst]</color> Increase the Stagger meter by one third of the <color=#FFA15E>Tremor</color> stacks, rounded up, then consume 1 <color=#FFA15E>Tremor</color>.
Each increase is capped at one third of the target's Willpower, rounded down. If Willpower is positive, the cap is at least 1.
The Stagger meter fills at the target's Willpower. At full, the target falls into a <color=#D196C7>Coma</color> for 1 action round. Afterward, the meter resets to zero.
The meter cannot build while the target is in a <color=#D196C7>Coma</color>.
<color=#55D8EF>[Turn End]</color> Lose 1 stack.

valenna.Buff.885133.Des.en: This status follows the standard <color=#F35D50>Burn</color> rules.

valenna.Buff.885134.Des.zh:
由<color=#FFA15E>震颤</color>转化，保留已有层数。后续施加的<color=#FFA15E>震颤</color>并入此状态。
<color=#FFA15E>[引爆时]</color> 结算普通<color=#FFA15E>震颤引爆</color>，再造成爆炸伤害。
爆炸伤害为引爆前<color=#F35D50>燃烧</color>与<color=#FFA15E>震颤</color>总层数的一半，向下取整。
<color=#F35D50>燃烧</color>与<color=#FFA15E>震颤</color>各额外减少原层数的三分之一，分别向下取整。
<color=#55D8EF>[回合结束时]</color> 减少⁣1层⁤。
valenna.Buff.885134.Des.en:
Converted from <color=#FFA15E>Tremor</color>. Retains existing stacks and absorbs new <color=#FFA15E>Tremor</color> stacks.
<color=#FFA15E>[On Burst]</color> Resolve a normal <color=#FFA15E>Tremor Burst</color>, then deal explosion damage.
Explosion damage equals half of the combined <color=#F35D50>Burn</color> and <color=#FFA15E>Tremor</color> stacks before the burst, rounded down.
<color=#F35D50>Burn</color> and <color=#FFA15E>Tremor</color> each lose an additional third of their original stacks, rounded down separately.
<color=#55D8EF>[Turn End]</color> Lose 1 stack.

valenna.Buff.885135.Des.zh:
⁣充能上限30层⁤。
每层使所有检定的⁣成功区间+1⁤。
<color=#55D8EF>[回合开始]</color> 未过热时，以<color=#8CD6EB>[预知]</color>替换闪避。
<color=#55D8EF>[回合开始时]</color> 战斗与探索均⁣恢复5层充能⁤。
<color=#EE827B>[受击时]</color> ⁣损失5层充能⁤。
<color=#55D8EF>[辅助闪避]</color> ⁣消耗5层充能⁤。
耗尽后转为<color=#8CD6EB>预知眼</color><color=#E77167>·过热</color>。
valenna.Buff.885135.Des.en:
Maximum charge is 30.
Each stack of charge increases the success range of all checks by 1.
<color=#55D8EF>[Turn Start]</color> If the <color=#8CD6EB>Eye of Precognition</color> is not overheated, replace your Dodge with [<color=#8CD6EB>Precognition</color>].
<color=#55D8EF>[Turn Start]</color> Recover 5 charge in combat and exploration.
<color=#EE827B>[When Hit]</color> Lose 5 charge.
<color=#55D8EF>[Assisted Dodge]</color> Spend 5 charge.
At zero charge, enter <color=#8CD6EB>Eye of Precognition</color><color=#E77167> - Overheat</color>.

valenna.Buff.885136.Des.zh:
<color=#E77167>[过热期间]</color> 闪避检定获得⁣1颗惩罚骰⁤。
<color=#55D8EF>[回合开始时]</color> 战斗与探索均积累⁣10层⁤。
达到⁣30层⁤时转回<color=#8CD6EB>预知眼</color>。
valenna.Buff.885136.Des.en:
<color=#E77167>[While Overheated]</color> Dodge checks receive 1 penalty die.
<color=#55D8EF>[Turn Start]</color> Build 10 stacks in combat and exploration.
At 30 stacks, return to <color=#8CD6EB>Eye of Precognition</color>.

valenna.Buff.885137.Des.zh:
⁣最多储存10发⁤。
<color=#55D8EF>[消耗时]</color> 每段只掷⁣1次射击暗骰⁤。
检定失败也会扣弹。
<color=#A8E96D>[检定成功时]</color> ⁣本段伤害+10%⁤。
每消耗⁣1发⁤，获得⁣1层<color=#EBC556>呼吸法</color>⁤。
valenna.Buff.885137.Des.en:
Store up to 10 rounds.
<color=#55D8EF>[On Spending]</color> Roll one hidden Shoot check per hit.
The round is spent even if the check fails.
<color=#A8E96D>[On Successful Check]</color> This hit deals +10% damage.
Gain 1 <color=#EBC556>Poise</color> per round spent.

valenna.Buff.885138.Des.zh:
<color=#A8E96D>[闪避成功时]</color> 若<color=#8CD6EB>预知眼</color>未处于过热状态，获得⁣1层⁤，上限⁣5层⁤。
每层提供⁣斗殴+2⁤、⁣运动+2⁤。
满⁣5层⁤时，非法术行动的检定获得⁣1颗奖励骰⁤。
<color=#55D8EF>[攻击时]</color> 每层使下次主动⁣攻击伤害+5%⁤，攻击后清空。
<color=#FFA15E>解兔</color>保留层数，也不触发这项增伤。
valenna.Buff.885138.Des.en:
<color=#A8E96D>[On Dodge]</color> Gain 1 stack if the <color=#8CD6EB>Eye of Precognition</color> is not overheated, up to 5.
Each stack grants Brawl +2 and Sport +2.
At 5 stacks, gain 1 bonus die on checks for actions other than spells.
<color=#55D8EF>[On Attack]</color> The next attack you initiate deals +5% damage per stack. Clear all stacks afterward.
<color=#FFA15E>Sezionatura di Coniglio</color> neither consumes the stacks nor gains their damage bonus.

valenna.Buff.885139.Des.zh:
受到标记者的⁣伤害+20%⁤。
⁣速度高于10⁤时：
⁣速度-50⁤，⁣最低降至10⁤。
<color=#EE827B>处置</color>只能锁定<color=#E76160>狩猎目标</color>。
valenna.Buff.885139.Des.en:
Take +20% damage from whoever marked you.
If your Speed is above 10, reduce it by 50 to a minimum of 10.
<color=#EE827B>Disposal</color> can only select the <color=#E76160>Game Target</color>.

valenna.Buff.885140.Des.zh:
⁣速度+50⁤。
战斗技能施加<color=#FFA15E>震颤</color>时，额外施加⁣1层⁤。
通过战斗技能获得<color=#EBC556>呼吸法</color>时，额外获得⁣1层⁤。
valenna.Buff.885140.Des.en:
Speed +50.
When a combat skill inflicts <color=#FFA15E>Tremor</color>, inflict 1 extra stack.
When a combat skill grants <color=#EBC556>Poise</color>, gain 1 extra stack.

valenna.Buff.885148.Des.zh: 引爆目标的<color=#FFA15E>震颤</color>，每次分别结算。若已转为<color=#F35D50>震颤·灼热</color>，同时结算其爆炸效果。
valenna.Buff.885148.Des.en: Trigger the target's <color=#FFA15E>Tremor Burst</color> and resolve each burst separately. If the status has become <color=#F35D50>Tremor - Scorch</color>, also resolve its explosion.

valenna.Buff.885150.Des.zh:
持续⁣12小时⁤。
<color=#55D8EF>[检定时]</color> 战斗与探索均获得⁣1颗惩罚骰⁤。
valenna.Buff.885150.Des.en:
Lasts 12 hours.
<color=#55D8EF>[On Check]</color> Receive 1 penalty die in combat and exploration.

valenna.Buff.885153.Des.zh:
每层使造成的⁣普通伤害+10%⁤。
<color=#55D8EF>[回合结束时]</color> 清除全部层数。
valenna.Buff.885153.Des.en:
Deal +10% normal damage per stack.
<color=#55D8EF>[Turn End]</color> Clear all stacks.

valenna.Buff.885154.Des.en: The fifth hit of this <color=#EE827B>Disposal</color> gains +2 base damage.

同时拥有「<color=#E76160>狩猎时刻</color>」时，开战自动指定<color=#E76160>狩猎目标</color>。
valenna.Trait.885141.Localization_Des.en:
Stealth -10.
Use the seven Palermo sword techniques in the attack menu.
With <color=#E76160>Time to Hunt</color>, automatically designate a <color=#E76160>Game Target</color> at the start of battle.

valenna.Trait.885142.Localization_Des.zh:
进入剧本或战斗时，自动装备专属神话物品<color=#8CD6EB>预知眼</color>。
<color=#8CD6EB>预知眼</color>未过热时，以<color=#8CD6EB>[预知]</color>替换闪避。使用预知闪避时，每层<color=#8CD6EB>预知眼</color>使本次检定成功区间额外⁣+1⁤。
成功闪避敌方一次普通攻击的全部段数后，以「<color=#FFA15E>解兔</color>」反击该敌人。
valenna.Trait.885142.Localization_Des.en:
Automatically equip the exclusive <color=#8CD6EB>Eye of Precognition</color> when entering a scenario or battle.
While the <color=#8CD6EB>Eye of Precognition</color> is active, [<color=#8CD6EB>Precognition</color>] replaces Dodge. When dodging with <color=#8CD6EB>Precognition</color>, each stack of <color=#8CD6EB>Eye of Precognition</color> adds 1 more to the check's success range.
After dodging every hit of a normal attack, counter with <color=#FFA15E>Sezionatura di Coniglio</color>.

valenna.Trait.885143.Localization_Des.zh:
<color=#55D8EF>[战斗开始时]</color> 随机标记一名敌人为<color=#E76160>狩猎目标</color>。
对猎物造成的⁣伤害+20%⁤。
猎物⁣速度高于10⁤时，⁣速度-50⁤，⁣最低降至10⁤。
<color=#EE827B>处置</color>锁定猎物，攻击后解除标记。若<color=#EE827B>处置</color>击杀猎物，下轮标记另一名敌人。
每⁣3个行动轮⁤结束时，若场上没有标记，下轮重新指定猎物。
<color=#A8E96D>[击杀猎物时]</color> 其余人类敌人进行意志检定，失败则陷入<color=#D196C7>恐惧</color>。
valenna.Trait.885143.Localization_Des.en:
<color=#55D8EF>[Battle Start]</color> Randomly mark one enemy as the <color=#E76160>Game Target</color>.
Deal +20% damage to the <color=#E76160>Game Target</color>.
If the <color=#E76160>Game Target</color> has more than 10 Speed, reduce its Speed by 50 to a minimum of 10.
<color=#EE827B>Disposal</color> locks onto the <color=#E76160>Game Target</color> and clears the mark after attacking. If it kills the <color=#E76160>Game Target</color>, mark another enemy next round.
At the end of every third action round, if no mark remains, designate a new <color=#E76160>Game Target</color> next round.
<color=#A8E96D>[On Killing the Game Target]</color> Other human enemies make a Willpower check. On failure, they gain <color=#D196C7>Fear</color>.

valenna.Trait.885144.Localization_Des.zh:
<color=#55D8EF>[进入剧本时]</color> 获得⁣1000资金⁤。
进入剧本及通关时，将上等雪茄补至⁣3支⁤、高浓度伏特加补至⁣1瓶⁤，并补满<color=#79CAD7>加速弹</color>。
<color=#55D8EF>[战斗开始时]</color> <color=#79CAD7>加速弹</color>补至⁣10发⁤。
valenna.Trait.885144.Localization_Des.en:
<color=#55D8EF>[On Entering a Scenario]</color> Gain 1,000 funds.
On entering or clearing a scenario, replenish your supply to 3 Fine Cigars and 1 bottle of High-Proof Vodka, and refill <color=#79CAD7>Acceleration Rounds</color>.
<color=#55D8EF>[Battle Start]</color> Refill <color=#79CAD7>Acceleration Rounds</color> to 10.
